TITAN-lite (detector version titan-lite-v1) association of MRMS reflectivity cells inside the places AOI (scope=conus on the large profile): each active track's polygon is advected to the new frame, cost = 1 - IoU (centroid distance fallback within 30 km per 10 min), solved with an in-house Hungarian assignment (greedy above 300 tracks); a cell overlapping two tracks merges them (the largest continues, others end with mergedInto) and a track overlapping two cells splits (children start with parentTrackId); a track absent for 2 frames ends. cell carries maxDbz (0.5), areaKm2 (2 significant figures), meshMaxMm and flashRate. history is the last 12 positions. motion.speedKmh to 5 km/h, motion.bearingDeg to 10 deg, method titan-lite-v1 with 3+ matches else centroid-v1. trend.maxDbz rising|steady|falling. lightningJump = {at, sigma, rateFpm, method 2sigma-glm-v1} for 10 minutes (advisory: GLM detection efficiency is below 100%). nowcast = +15/+30/+60 min linear-advection leads; the record geometry is a GeometryCollection of the current and nowcast polygons. Emitted on change; tombstoned 30 min after ended. Automated, not a warning.

storm-swath.note: externalId = the storm track's id. The union of the cell polygons along the track (its swath), plus meshMaxMm and the duration in minutes; rewritten every 10 minutes while the track is active and when it ends. Tombstoned with its track.

uv-forecast.note: externalId = place:{placeId}; the hourly UV index forecast for a US ZIP (the place's attributes.zip), in the place's timezone. hours = [{time, uv}] for the next hours; maxUv/maxAt are the peak. Missing when the place has no zip.

dcp-observation.note: externalId = the DCP address. A DCS (Data Collection Platform) message from SatDump's parse_dcs JSON, resolved to a location through the dcp_location table; messages without a location, outside dcsBbox or not allowlisted are dropped. Emit on change; 3 d retention.

emwin-product.note: externalId = {wmoHeading}:{awipsId}:{issue}. An EMWIN product from the owner's GOES HRIT reception, filtered to the allowed AWIPS categories. text <= 16 KB, untrusted, embedded for search. 3 d retention.

emwin-warning.note: externalId = {office}.{phen}.{sig}.{etn}, so an update to the same warning versions the same record; CAN/EXP tombstone. A P-VTEC warning with a LAT...LON polygon intersecting the places AOI. fallback:true; authoritativeSource nws-alerts. duplicateOf is present only while nws-alerts is healthy and holds the same VTEC.

wind-probability.note: Built in 127. nhc-wind-probs (NOAA NHC_tropical_weather_summary MapServer, layers Probabilistic Winds 34, 50 and 64 kts, ids 30, 31 and 32 on 2026-10-17, resolved by name): one polygon per published band of the field percentage (<5%, 5-10%, 10-20% … 80-90%, >90%), the cumulative probability that sustained winds of at least thresholdKt occur at a point within 120 hours of the advisory, for all active storms together (no storm id). externalId {kt}kt:{low}-{high} in percent (34kt:40-50; <5% is 0-5, >90% is 90-100); pMin and pMax are the bounds as probabilities; observedAt = validFrom = idp_filedate, validUntil 120 h later. Bands are tombstoned per layer once missing from two consecutive complete fetches; out of season every layer is empty. Analytic class event (1825 d).

watermarkSeq.description: ChangeBus.lastPublishedSeq() read before the query; open SSE with after=watermarkSeq

asOfSeq.description: Echo of the pinned snapshot seq (asOfSeq or order=id)

asOf.description: Echo of asOf

approximate.description: asOf only: true when a source is SAMPLED/LATEST or the range is downsampled

horizon.description: asOf only: earliest supported T over the involved sources

attributions.description: Aggregated attributions of the records in this page

licenceFiltered.description: Records removed by the licence policy

ingestedAt.description: Version-based features only (history and asOf): the batch time of the version

watermarkSeq.description: ChangeBus.lastPublishedSeq() read before the query; open SSE with after=watermarkSeq

asOfSeq.description: Echo of the pinned snapshot seq (asOfSeq or order=id)

asOf.description: Echo of asOf

approximate.description: asOf only: true when a source is SAMPLED/LATEST or the range is downsampled

horizon.description: asOf only: earliest supported T over the involved sources

payload.description: Present with payload=true, and always for kinds in `inlinePayloadKinds` (default raster-frame)

prevSeq.description: seq of the previous version; null for FIRST

validUntil.description: Effective expiry; offline mirrors drop the record after it

qaFlags.description: Quality bitmask: 1 FUTURE_CLAMPED, 2 GEOMETRY_FIXED, 4 NULL_ISLAND, 8 TIME_IMPUTED, 16 POSITION_STALE

prevPersistedBbox.description: SSE only: bbox of the previous persisted version

prevLiveBbox.description: SSE only: bbox of the live position before this version

leftFilter.description: SSE only: only a previous box matched the spatial filter; remove the feature

purged.description: Tombstone written by an entity purge: clients and caches delete the entity (039)

lastSeq.description: Pass as `after` next time. When `hasMore` is false it is at least the `watermarkSeq` read before the query, so a filtered client skips past seqs that matched nothing

purgeHorizon.description: Max RetentionState.purgeSeq over the filtered sources; after < purgeHorizon → 410 RESYNC_REQUIRED

path.description: Dot path into payload. Required for every operator except inWatchlist and notInWatchlist, which without a path read each source's declared identity field (descriptor entityKeys, 036); a source that does not declare the watchlist's identity never matches

op.description: Comparison ops take numbers (== and != also strings and booleans); in/notIn a non-empty homogeneous scalar array (≤ 1000); exists a boolean; startsWith a string ≤ 256; matches a Java regex ≤ 256 without backreferences, lookaround or nested quantifiers (only (?:…) groups and the escapes \d \D \w \W \s \S \n \t \r \f, so PostgreSQL reads it the same way). A value of another JSON type than the operator expects, a missing path or JSON null never matches (except exists); string operators need a JSON string (the number 5 does not equal "5"); != and notIn need the value present. inWatchlist/notInWatchlist (036) take a watchlist id; the payload value must be a JSON string or number (compared by its JSON text after the list's normalization); anything else, a missing path or JSON null never matches either operator.

geofence.description: Polygon/MultiPolygon, or LineString/MultiLineString with bufferMeters (buffered server-side as ST_Buffer(line::geography, bufferMeters)); ≤ 10,000 vertices; fixed, split at the antimeridian and stored as MultiPolygon. Mutually exclusive with near. When `geofenceRoute` (a line) is sent together with bufferMeters, the route is the input and `geofence` is ignored, so a rule read back can be sent back unchanged.

mode.description: match: every matching non-HEARTBEAT version. enter: matches and the previous version did not (or was a tombstone, or is new). exit: the previous version matched and this one does not or is a tombstone. Edge modes need a geofence, near or a condition.

messageTemplate.description: Placeholders {{name}}, {{source}}, {{externalId}}, {{kind}}, {{title}}, {{severity}}, {{observedAt}}, {{eventTime}}, {{time}}, {{validFrom}}, {{payload.<path>}}; region placeholders (040), empty when unknown: {{near.name}}, {{near.km}}, {{near.mi}}, {{near.bearing}} (16-point compass), {{near.text}} ("12 km NNE of Austin, TX"; miles with {{near.text|imperial}} or a channel's config.units=imperial), {{country}} (ISO2), {{country.name}}, {{admin1}}, {{admin1.name}}, {{county}} (the county name, else its FIPS5) and {{sea}}

enrich.description: Add an LLM context summary to each alert (030). Accepted without a chat provider: the flag is stored and enrichment is skipped until one is assigned and llm.enrichmentEnabled is on

enrichWindow.description: Context window around the alert for enrichment (030): ISO-8601 duration or shorthand, 10m to 7d

tags.description: Copied to alerts

bufferMeters.description: Required when geofence is a LineString/MultiLineString: corridor half-width (1–50,000 m)

hysteresisMeters.description: Edge band for enter/exit geofence and near rules (0–5,000 m, default 0): an enter edge needs the position inside the fence shrunk by the band, an exit edge outside the fence grown by it, and edges per (rule, entity) alternate, so jitter along a boundary fires nothing. 400 GEOFENCE_TOO_SMALL_FOR_HYSTERESIS when the shrunk fence is empty.

near.description: Places, point or moving anchor (036); materialised into geofence

reappearAsEnter.description: Fire enter on REAPPEAR (default true with a geofence, else false)

autoResolve.description: true = all defaults on, false/null = off; not allowed on exit rules

maxAlertsPerHour.description: Storm cap per rule (null → triggers.defaultMaxAlertsPerHour, default 120; 0 = unlimited)

activeUntil.description: Rule is disabled automatically after this time

forecastHorizon.description: Fire on versions whose validFrom ≤ evaluation time + horizon (400 FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE without validFrom). ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

geofenceRef.description: Region preset instead of a polygon (040); 409 REFERENCE_DATA_MISSING when reference data is absent

weatherContext.description: Compute `alert.context.weather` for this rule's geolocated alerts (global setting `weather.alertContext`)

type.description: Rule type; existing rules are `record`. `onlyNew`, `mode` and `reappearAsEnter` are rejected for windowed types (400 WINDOW_RULE_INVALID).

window.description: Window spec for count, absence and anomaly rules; the rule `type` selects the variant

TriggerRuleInput.description: All conditions are ANDed. At least one of sources, kinds, conditions, geofence or near is required. Unknown sources → 400; unknown kinds warn.

suppressedCount.description: Alerts suppressed by the storm cap

geofenceRoute.description: Original line of a buffered route geofence (display only); `geofence` holds the materialised MultiPolygon

anchorStatus.description: Moving-anchor state (036); stale suspends the rule (ANCHOR_STALE)

ownerPrincipalId.description: The principal of the user who owns the rule (R2-008); null for a shared rule managed by an admin. Ignored on input.

simulated.description: True when simulate=true (cooldown, cap and active windows applied)

enrich.description: True when the rule would enrich; no LLM is called by testTrigger

warnings.description: Warnings, e.g. DOWNSAMPLED_RANGE: match-mode results over downsampled history under-count; edge reasons are preserved

approximateReason.example: versions only; entities observed without a new version inside the window are missed when window < source keyframe

items.description: Windowed test result at one step instant

ruleName.description: The rule's current name; null when the rule was deleted (its alerts are kept)

summary.description: LLM context summary when the rule has enrich=true (030): at most about 120 words with [source:externalId@seq] and [alert:id] citations (unverifiable ones removed); null until enriched, and when enrichment was skipped or failed

enrichedAt.description: When the summary was stored (030); null until enriched

record.description: The version (seq) if still retained; otherwise use recordSnapshot

rev.description: Monotonic revision (SSE id on /v1/alerts/stream); bumps on every change

observedAt.description: observedAt of the matching version (cooldown axis)

resolvedBy.description: inverse_edge, tombstone, expiry, stale, admin or token:<name>

summaryCitations.description: Verified citations of the enrichment summary (030); empty until enriched

sensitive.description: Alert from a rule referencing a watchlist (036): hidden from anonymous and feed-key principals

region.description: Region tags snapshotted at fire time (040)

exercise.description: Exercise replay alert (never counted in real state or statistics)

signals.description: Implicit quality signals recorded for this alert

sources.description: Per-source overrides (view over source_settings.retention); TRACK sources → 400 RETENTION_TIER_FIXED

trackWindow.description: Single window of the TRACK tier. ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

provenance.description: fetch_log rows with versions. ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

notifications.description: notification rows. ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

kinds.description: Per-kind windows (STANDARD only), first in the resolution order

stats.description: Retention of 038 activity rollups and 119 region rollups

inbox.description: Notification inbox retention (033). Separate from `notifications` (delivery rows, 019).

trackRawWindow.description: TRACK history older than this is downsampled; null disables (must be < trackWindow). ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

trackDownsampleInterval.description: One sample per entity per interval in downsampled leaves (30s ≤ interval ≤ trackRawWindow). ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

entityLinks.description: How long closed entity links are kept (098; default 365d). ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

social.description: Analytic class `social` (135): `social-post` retention per platform (view over `social.postRetention`); narratives, claims, comparisons and volume series are kept as intel and series

capHistory.description: Cap history (R2-015): one bound over the data history (records, TRACK history, frames, media and stopped chronicles). Off (the default) keeps every window as configured. When on, `maxDays` clamps every window to at most that many days (it never lengthens one, and cutoffs still pass the consumer clamp) and `maxDbGb` keeps the database under that size. Needs `maxDays`, `maxDbGb` or both.

maxDays.description: With `capHistory`: keep at most this many days of data history. An upper bound over the per-kind, per-source and tier windows, never a replacement.

maxDbGb.description: With `capHistory`: keep the database (`pg_database_size`) under this many GB (1024³ bytes). When it is over and still growing, each run steps the history window down (halving, whole days, never below 1 day) oldest first; when that cannot reach the cap it raises `system.retention_cap_unmet` and shortens history no further. An entity reported within the window keeps its current record.

overwriteOldest.description: With `maxDbGb`: step the history window down to stay under the cap (default true); false only reports the breach.

RetentionSettings.description: Retention windows (Core-Data-Model §13). PUT replaces the whole object; every duration ≥ 1h. STANDARD windows resolve in order: kinds.{kind}, sources.{id} (a view over source_settings.retention), the descriptor's kindRetention, its defaultRetention, then default; TRACK always uses trackWindow. Members owned by later prompts (see x-foresignal-property-prompts) are accepted and not stored until those prompts.

skippedSources.description: Sources skipped this run after a failed delete (no HeadPurge)

capWindowDays.description: The cap-history window this run applied, in days (R2-015); null when history is not capped by age

dbCap.description: What the database-size cap did this run (R2-015); null when it is off

sizeBeforeBytes.description: Database size after the window pass

bytesReclaimed.description: How far the size fell during the cap steps. Deleted rows free space Postgres reuses; files shrink only on a partition drop or VACUUM FULL.

windowDays.description: History window in force at the end, or null for the configured windows

deleted.description: Rows deleted by the cap steps, by table

triggers.description: Trigger rules with their ids; import upserts by id

id.description: The channel id; import upserts by it

channels.description: Channels without secrets: ChannelInput plus id. Import upserts by id; a channel imported without secrets keeps the ones it has.

pushProviders.description: Without secrets (032). Import upserts by id: an existing provider keeps its key; a new one is stored disabled until an admin sets its key.

warnings.description: Export warnings (036): places reveal locations; watchlists identify what is followed

features.description: Capability flags from FeatureContributor beans (notifications, retention, later llm, search, push, mcp, weather …); 113 adds federation and federationServing, and in edge mode reports embeddings, llm, search, ask, rasters, briefings, ogc, exports and federationServing false

downsampledLeaves.description: TRACK leaves thinned by history downsampling (044); 0 for STANDARD

catchingUp.description: lag > 10,000 seq or ingest queue > 80% for > 1 min

code.description: OPEN_READS_EXPOSED, OPEN_READS_ALL_INTERFACES, HISTORY_RATE_HIGH, PARTITION_HEADROOM_LOW, RETENTION_CONSUMER_LAG, RASTER_DISK_QUOTA (042: the raster store is at 90 % of its quota or more) (open set)

anonymousRestricted.description: True when the anonymous profile restricts anything beyond its defaults

mode.description: Deployment profile; in edge mode `features` reports embeddings, LLM, rasters, briefings, OGC, exports and federation serving off

SystemInfo.description: System document. Anonymous callers get only version, apiVersion, startedAt, uptimeSeconds, status, features and limits; any valid token gets the full document.

openReads.description: When false, data GETs require a read token

exposeObserver.description: Return record observers to read-scope and anonymous callers with include=observer

anonymous.description: Anonymous restriction profile applied to tokenless reads while openReads is true (035). Default: no source/kind/area limits, private excluded, data GETs only (never inbox, places, watchlists or alwaysAuthenticated operations), 120 requests/min

metricsOpen.description: When false, /actuator/prometheus requires an admin token (035)

exposeMlat.description: When false (the default), records whose `posSource` is `mlat` are stripped from anonymous openReads responses of the records API (list, get, versions, history, asOf); a record whose `posSource` was projected away by `fields=` is stripped too when its source reports `posSource`. MLAT positions are never sent on sinks, federation, share links or feeds regardless (069)

publicBaseUrl.description: Base URL used in notification links; null uses the request's own scheme, host and port

timezone.description: IANA zone; fallback for channel timezones

warnings.description: PUBLIC_BASE_URL_INSECURE when publicBaseUrl is http:// on a non-local host; PUBLIC_BASE_URL_MISMATCH when requests arrive over https

contactEmail.description: Operator contact appended to the upstream User-Agent as `contact=…` (the NWS API asks for a contact); null for none

principalId.description: Owning principal (id or handle); default: a new principal named after the token; not accepted by createMyToken, whose tokens are always the caller's (R2-025)

licencePolicy.description: Licence policy floor applied to every read with this token; requests may add flags but never remove these

restrictions.description: Data and endpoint restrictions (data restrictions enforced from 035)

createdVia.description: `self`: minted by a signed-in user with createMyToken and owned by that user's principal (R2-025)

principalId.description: Owning principal (every token belongs to one principal)

licencePolicy.description: Licence policy floor applied to every read with this token; requests may add flags but never remove these

observedAtMode.description: Time base; changeable only while the source has no heads (409 OBSERVED_AT_MODE_LOCKED). Under UPSTREAM a record without observedAt is rejected MISSING_OBSERVED_AT.

volatileFields.description: Excluded from the hash; editing triggers lazy recipe migration

private.description: Private source (039); cannot be unset for profile personal-location

profile.description: Preset defaults (039): personal-location = private, STANDARD, kind tracker, UPSTREAM + OBSERVED anchor, 24h TTL, 7d retention, SAMPLED policy, no embedding, no enrichment

mapping.description: RecordMapping used by the `mapping` ingest format and the device-preset formats (replaces 024's interim JSON-Pointer mapping under formats.mapping). Compiled against this input's kinds and observedAtMode (400 MAPPING_INVALID with per-path errors); editing it publishes the custom-source change event

preset.description: Create only: a MappingPreset id (`GET /v1/mappings/presets`) whose defaults fill every member the input leaves out (kinds, fieldSpecs, observedAtMode, recordTtl, significantFields, volatileFields, private, allowPathKey, tileProperties, titleField, mapping, format options) and whose format becomes the default of `POST /v1/ingest/{sourceId}`. On update it may only repeat the stored value

presetParams.description: Create only: preset parameters, e.g. `lon`, `lat` (rounded to 0.01° unless `exactLocation=true`)

allowPathKey.description: Accept the ingest key in the path (`/v1/ingest/{sourceId}/k/{key}/{format}`)

ingestAllowCidrs.description: Sender allowlist; null = private ranges only (loopback, RFC 1918, link-local, ULA) when a path key, query key or GET is used. Others → 403 INGEST_SOURCE_DENIED

captureSamples.description: Keep the last 5 raw requests in memory (redacted) for `/samples`; auto-off 1 h after it is turned on (a PUT that keeps it on does not extend the window; turning it off drops the samples)

licenceTerms.description: Licence of pushed data, snapshotted on each PUSH batch

setup.description: Device setup instructions with the concrete URL (contains the key; shown once) when created from a preset

reason.description: Rejection reason code (normalizer, prompt 008): EXTERNAL_ID_INVALID, UNKNOWN_KIND, MISSING_OBSERVED_AT, OBSERVED_AT_TOO_OLD, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, PAYLOAD_TOO_DEEP, PAYLOAD_TOO_MANY_KEYS, PAYLOAD_STRING_TOO_LONG, PAYLOAD_NON_FINITE_NUMBER, PAYLOAD_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE, TOO_MANY_OBSERVERS, GEOMETRY_TOO_MANY_VERTICES, GEOMETRY_WRONG_SRID, COORDINATES_OUT_OF_RANGE, QUALITY_INVALID, VALID_RANGE_INVERTED. Format rejections (024, 039): INVALID_ITEM, LOW_ACCURACY (accuracy worse than maxAccuracyMeters), INVALID_FIX (valid=false, missing or out-of-range coordinates), NULL_ISLAND (exact 0,0), ENCRYPTED_UNSUPPORTED (OwnTracks payload encryption). Later prompts may add codes.

live.description: Observations written as live-only updates, without a version

touched.description: Observations written as touches (unchanged content, refreshed observedAt, lastReceivedAt and validity)

byReason.description: Persisted versions per persist reason; every reason is present, zeros included: FIRST, REAPPEAR, SIGNIFICANT, TOMBSTONE, CHANGE, SAMPLE, KEYFRAME, HEARTBEAT, TRIGGER_EDGE

secretFields.description: Write-only fields; a name of the form `prefix.<Name>` is a wildcard (webhook `header.<Name>` sends any such secret as the header <Name>)

items.description: Expected to grow (`x-extensible-enum`): a client must accept a value not listed here.

events.description: The events a channel of this type can subscribe to: every `Channel.events` value an instance channel accepts

type.description: teams accepts only Power Automate Workflows URLs (Office 365 connector URLs → 400); webpush is the built-in Push channel (031): created at startup with a fixed id, updatable but not creatable (400); its config takes quietHoursMode (defer|downgrade|drop); mqtt (060) publishes on the operator's broker (config MqttChannelConfig, secrets username, password, caCertPem): events on {prefix}/alerts/{severity}, {prefix}/alerts/updates, {prefix}/briefings/{briefingId} and {prefix}/system/events, plus retained state and optional Home Assistant discovery; a public broker without TLS or credentials is saved with the warning MQTT_INSECURE_PUBLIC_BROKER; meshtastic (084) sends compact alert lines through the node's MQTT JSON downlink (config MeshtasticChannelConfig, secrets username, password) and meshcore (084) through the MeshCore companion protocol (config MeshcoreChannelConfig); both refuse public or default channels with MESH_PUBLIC_CHANNEL, pass every transmission through a LoRa airtime governor and take only alert.resolved among lifecycle updates

config.description: Non-secret settings per the type's configFields, plus the map-attachment keys

allowedUserIds.description: telegram: who may press action buttons (empty = any chat member)

oneOf.description: matrix: who may acknowledge by reaction
meshtastic, meshcore (084): sender to role; see MeshChannelCommonConfig.allowedSenders

allowedSenders.description: matrix: an array of user ids who may acknowledge by reaction; meshtastic and meshcore (084): an object of sender (`!xxxxxxxx`, `mc:` + 12 hex, or `name:` + advertised name) to role `report` or `ack`

privatePayload.description: Admin opt-in to include private-source payloads (039); otherwise rule name, severity and a link only

units.description: Units of the {{near.text}} placeholder in this channel's templates (040)

secrets.description: Write-only secret settings per the type's secretFields. A secretFields entry named `prefix.<Name>` (webhook `header.<Name>`) accepts any secret whose name starts with the prefix.

events.description: Default ["alert"]. The personal-notice events (`mention`, `share`, `report.received`, `package.received`, `chronicle.proposed`, `chronicle.cap_warning`, `chronicle.gap`, `chronicle.access.requested`, `saved-search.matches`) deliver a copy of each such notice, once per addressee, with its TLP label at the head

timezone.description: IANA timezone for quiet hours and `|local` template filters (default: the `server` setting's timezone, else UTC)

quietHours.description: Quiet hours in the channel timezone; null for none

groupWindowSeconds.description: > 0 holds the first alert per (channel, rule) for the window and sends one grouped message

backlogCap.description: Pending sends above this are folded into one digest ("+N more alerts")

editInPlace.description: Edit the original message on lifecycle updates where the type supports it (Discord, Telegram, Matrix)

deferWhileActiveSeconds.description: Defer non-critical alerts while a desktop client is active (033); for phone-type channels

language.description: BCP 47 language for notifications on this channel (141), stored canonicalized (`pt-br` → `pt-BR`); null uses `notify.defaultLanguage`. When the primary language or script differs from it, title and body are translated through the 026 chat role (budget `translate`, low effort), code spans, URLs and placeholders untouched, cached 24 h; after 8 s, or on any failure, the original is sent with the title prefixed `[untranslated]`.

global.description: On create only (R2-009): true for a global channel (needs `channels.global`), false for a personal one (needs `self.channels`). Absent, a user holding `self.channels` gets a personal channel and anyone else a global one; an API token always creates global channels. Ignored on update.

allowedUserIds.description: telegram: who may press action buttons (empty = any chat member)

oneOf.description: matrix: who may acknowledge by reaction
meshtastic, meshcore (084): sender to role; see MeshChannelCommonConfig.allowedSenders

allowedSenders.description: matrix: an array of user ids who may acknowledge by reaction; meshtastic and meshcore (084): an object of sender (`!xxxxxxxx`, `mc:` + 12 hex, or `name:` + advertised name) to role `report` or `ack`

privatePayload.description: Admin opt-in to include private-source payloads (039); otherwise rule name, severity and a link only

units.description: Units of the {{near.text}} placeholder in this channel's templates (040)

config.description: Non-secret settings per the type's configFields, plus the map-attachment keys

secretFields.description: Names of the secret fields that are set (values are never returned)

items.description: Expected to grow (`x-extensible-enum`): a client must accept a value not listed here.

events.description: The subscribed events. `personal` marks a principal's personal channel (prompt 130), which carries only that principal's notifications; createChannel and updateChannel never accept it. `mention`, `share`, `report.received`, `package.received`, `chronicle.proposed`, `chronicle.cap_warning`, `chronicle.gap`, `chronicle.access.requested` and `saved-search.matches` on an instance channel receive a copy of each such personal notice, once per addressee, with its TLP label at the head; the copies never reach the device inbox or the instance SSE topics

timezone.description: IANA timezone for quiet hours and `|local` template filters (default: the `server` setting's timezone, else UTC)

groupWindowSeconds.description: > 0 holds the first alert per (channel, rule) for the window and sends one grouped message

backlogCap.description: Pending sends above this are folded into one digest ("+N more alerts")

editInPlace.description: Edit the original message on lifecycle updates where the type supports it (Discord, Telegram, Matrix)

deferWhileActiveSeconds.description: Defer non-critical alerts while a desktop client is active (033); for phone-type channels

warnings.description: Non-fatal configuration warnings, e.g. MQTT_INSECURE_PUBLIC_BROKER (060); absent when there are none

interactive.description: Interactive chat-command status for telegram/matrix channels (061)

language.description: BCP 47; when it differs from `notify.defaultLanguage` (primary language or script) title and body are translated (026 chat role, budget `translate`), cached 24 h, the original with an `[untranslated]` title marker after 8 s or on failure (141)

ownerPrincipalId.description: The principal of the user who owns this personal channel (R2-009); null for a global channel.

global.description: True for a global (instance-wide) channel, managed with `channels.global` (R2-009).

event.description: Expected to grow (`x-extensible-enum`): a client must accept a value not listed here.

deferredReason.description: `airtime` = held by a mesh channel's LoRa airtime governor (084); released as one digest line.

edited.description: An update delivered by editing the original message

attachmentLevel.description: Size-control level chosen for this channel (800 px → 600 px → 256 px thumbnail → text only)

attachments.description: Media references sent (bytes load from the media store at send time, so retries work)

shortCode.description: 4-character Crockford base32 alert code used by mesh channels so `#E ACK <code>` finds the alert (084)

temperature.description: Sampling temperature 0–2 for openai-compatible and ollama providers; refused for anthropic (current Claude models control depth with effort)

extraHeaders.description: Extra request headers (for example OpenRouter `HTTP-Referer`); Authorization, x-api-key, Content-Type and the anthropic-* headers are reserved

local.description: Treat this provider as local for LLM egress (private-source records may be sent to it, 026/039); `ollama` is always local

ttsModel.description: Speech model for the `tts` role (141), sent as `model` to `{baseUrl}/audio/speech`; openai-compatible only (for example `tts-1`, `gpt-4o-mini-tts`, `kokoro`)

ttsCharactersPerDay.description: Daily character budget of the `tts` role (141), per UTC day

knowledgeCutoff.description: Training-data cutoff of the chat model (`YYYY-MM-DD`)

pricing.description: Prices in USD per million tokens (162); null or omitted means unpriced. Required for a USD cap.

hourlyCapUsd.description: The most this provider may spend in the UTC clock hour (it resets at the top of the hour), in USD, at most 4 decimal places; null means no cap (162). Spend is the provider's self-metered tokens at its `pricing`, so a cap needs pricing. Once a window's spend, with the estimated cost of the calls in flight, reaches its cap, calls are refused 429 LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with Retry-After at the window's reset. Applies on top of requestsPerMinute and tokensPerDay.

dailyCapUsd.description: The most this provider may spend in the UTC day (it resets at 00:00 UTC, as tokensPerDay), in USD, at most 4 decimal places; null means no cap (162). Spend is the provider's self-metered tokens at its `pricing`, so a cap needs pricing. Once a window's spend, with the estimated cost of the calls in flight, reaches its cap, calls are refused 429 LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with Retry-After at the window's reset. Applies on top of requestsPerMinute and tokensPerDay.

monthlyCapUsd.description: The most this provider may spend in the UTC calendar month (it resets at 00:00 UTC on the 1st), in USD, at most 4 decimal places; null means no cap (162). Spend is the provider's self-metered tokens at its `pricing`, so a cap needs pricing. Once a window's spend, with the estimated cost of the calls in flight, reaches its cap, calls are refused 429 LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with Retry-After at the window's reset. Applies on top of requestsPerMinute and tokensPerDay.

shared.description: On create: true for a shared provider (needs `llm.shared.manage`), false for a personal one owned by the caller (needs `self.llm`). Absent, a user holding `self.llm` gets a personal provider and anyone else a shared one; an API token always creates shared providers. Ignored on replace, which keeps the kind (R2-011).

perUserHourlyCapUsd.description: The most each user may spend on this shared provider in the UTC clock hour (it resets at the top of the hour), in USD, at most 4 decimal places; null means no per-user cap (R2-011). It counts only that user's own calls, so one user cannot exhaust the shared budget while the others continue; the provider's own caps still bound the total. Needs `pricing`; refused for a personal provider, whose own caps are already its owner's. Once reached, that user's calls are refused 429 LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with Retry-After at the window's reset.

perUserDailyCapUsd.description: The most each user may spend on this shared provider in the UTC day (it resets at 00:00 UTC), in USD, at most 4 decimal places; null means no per-user cap (R2-011). It counts only that user's own calls, so one user cannot exhaust the shared budget while the others continue; the provider's own caps still bound the total. Needs `pricing`; refused for a personal provider, whose own caps are already its owner's. Once reached, that user's calls are refused 429 LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with Retry-After at the window's reset.

perUserMonthlyCapUsd.description: The most each user may spend on this shared provider in the UTC calendar month (it resets at 00:00 UTC on the 1st), in USD, at most 4 decimal places; null means no per-user cap (R2-011). It counts only that user's own calls, so one user cannot exhaust the shared budget while the others continue; the provider's own caps still bound the total. Needs `pricing`; refused for a personal provider, whose own caps are already its owner's. Once reached, that user's calls are refused 429 LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with Retry-After at the window's reset.

supportsTools.description: False when the chat model rejected tools; Ask then runs retrieval-only

knowledgeCutoff.description: Training-data cutoff of the chat model; required for leak-free retrospective evaluation of LLM forecasters

local.description: Treated as local for LLM egress (ollama, or `options.local=true`)

pricing.description: Prices in USD per million tokens (162); every member null when unpriced

hourlyCapUsd.description: USD cap of the UTC clock hour (it resets at the top of the hour), or null (162)

dailyCapUsd.description: USD cap of the UTC day (it resets at 00:00 UTC, as tokensPerDay), or null (162)

monthlyCapUsd.description: USD cap of the UTC calendar month (it resets at 00:00 UTC on the 1st), or null (162)

shared.description: True for a shared provider (no owner, managed with `llm.shared.manage`); false for a user's personal provider (R2-011)

It counts only that user's own calls, so one user cannot exhaust the shared budget while the others continue; the provider's own caps still bound the total. allowPrivateLocal.description: Allow private-source records in prompts for providers classified as local (039): Ollama or `options.local`, whose base URL resolves only to loopback or private addresses. Never for remote providers. Default false.

status.description: pending until the verification code is echoed; active receives notifications; disabled after three consecutive failed send-time address rechecks (URL_NOT_ALLOWED)

licence.description: Licence in force for this version (fetch_log.licence of its batch, or an override)

reliability.description: Admiralty source reliability: A completely reliable, B usually reliable, C fairly reliable, D not usually reliable, E unreliable, F cannot be judged

chain.description: Federation: origin first, one hop appended per instance that re-served the record

ObjectEnvelope.description: Uniform summary of any Foresignal object (docs/Client-Contract.md §3)

sidc.description: Optional MIL-STD-2525 symbol identification code (15 or 20 characters)

rotateField.description: Payload field rotating the icon (e.g. `track`); must be in tileProperties

sizeField.description: Payload field scaling circle radius (e.g. `frp`, `mag`); must be in tileProperties

iconField.description: Payload field choosing the icon through `iconCases` (e.g. `chartSymbol`); must be in tileProperties

courseField.description: Top-level payload key holding course over ground (degrees)

keyframe.description: Keyframe interval on the TTL-anchor axis: a duration or `none` (only without a TTL). ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

keyframe.description: Keyframe interval on the TTL-anchor axis: a duration or `none` (only without a TTL). ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

minDeviationMeters.description: Dead-reckoning deviation that triggers a SAMPLE

thresholds.description: Also sample when a descriptor threshold is exceeded

minInterval.description: Minimum interval (2 s ≤ minInterval ≤ keyframe). ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

keyframe.description: Keyframe interval on the TTL-anchor axis: a duration or `none` (only without a TTL). ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

edgeMinInterval.description: Minimum Δt between TRIGGER_EDGE versions. ISO-8601 duration (P7D, PT15M) or shorthand (7d, 15m, 12h)

SourceStorage.description: Storage cost of a source (Core-Data-Model §15), from source_usage

triggerEdgeShare.description: Share of versions persisted as TRIGGER_EDGE over the last hour (warning above 0.2)

urlRedacted.description: Last request URL with credentials redacted

nextAfter.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last page

KindSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 document merged from the fieldSpecs of every source emitting a kind, with `x-unit`, `x-unitLabel`, `x-label`, `x-format`, `x-display` and `x-conflicts` extensions. Each property may also carry `x-datum` (vertical datum of a length field); `TIMESTAMP` fields are `["string", "integer"]` with `x-format: timestamp`; each `oneOf` variant of a conflicting field lists its `x-sources`.

dn.description: Numeric rank for rules such as dn >= 5

frpMw.description: Fire radiative power, MW. goes-fdc and hms-fire: 2 significant figures; nasa-firms: the FIRMS frp column as sent

source.description: `HMS` for hms-fire; the FIRMS product (for example `VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT`) for nasa-firms

SatellitePassPayload.description: Payload of `satellite-pass` records (externalId `{station}:{satKey}:{aosEpochMinute}`); geometry: polar GeoTIFF footprint → approximate SGP4 swath → station point (054), named by `geometrySource`

status.description: `predicted` (064: Orekit from `celestrak-gp` elements), then `receiving`, `recorded`, `decoded` or `failed` (049); `missed` (064) when a predicted pass had no session by LOS + 20 min while the station was healthy (otherwise the predicted pass is tombstoned)

productId.description: The polar overlay product `satdump-{station}-{composite}` (054); present when the composite has a GeoTIFF overlay

geometrySource.description: Present when the record geometry is not the station point: `footprint` (the alpha-mask outline of the pass's polar GeoTIFF overlays, 054) or `swath` (an approximate SGP4 swath from the TLE, used when no GeoTIFF was usable; never tiled)

tca.description: Predicted time of maximum elevation (064, predicted passes)

imminent.description: 064 `satellite-passes`: true from 15 minutes before AOS until LOS (a new version near AOS, so `forecastHorizon` rules, which match `validFrom` = AOS on new versions only, and plain `imminent == true` rules can fire)

WxAreaPayload.description: Payload of `wx-area` records (externalId `{field}:{threshold}:{aoi}`); geometry null when empty

NwsForecastPayload.description: Payload of `nws-forecast` records (nws-gridpoints, externalId `place:{placeId}`; no geometry, since a place's position is sensitive)

StormReportPayload.description: Payload of `storm-report` records (spc-storm-reports; never tombstoned on absence)

magnitude.description: Tornado rating string (EF0 to EF5), wind mph or hail inches as numbers; omitted when UNK

MapStyle.description: MapLibre Style Spec version-8 overlay document generated from kind display hints (058). Overlay only: no `glyphs`, no text layers, no basemap.

sources.description: One `vector` source per requested layer (`url` = 016 per-layer TileJSON) plus `agg=hex` sources used below `aggBelowZoom`

layers.description: MapLibre layers: `symbol` (SDF icon, colour match, rotation), `circle` (zoom/size interpolation), `line`, `fill` (opacity 0.25) plus outline, and aggregation `fill` ramps

MapSpriteIndex.description: MapLibre sprite index (`foresignal-{sha8}[@2x].json`): icon name → position in the sheet; all icons are SDF (058)

JsonFeed.description: JSON Feed 1.1 document for alerts or briefing runs (058). Property names follow the JSON Feed spec (snake_case).

JsonFeedItem.description: One JSON Feed item (alert or briefing run) with the `_foresignal` extension (058)

content_html.description: Markdown rendered with commonmark-java and sanitised by the allowlist policy

tags.description: Severity and rule tags

MappingValueSpec.description: One mapping value: a Jayway JSONPath (item-relative under `select`; `$pairs.<key>` reads a flattened pair), a substitution-only template, or a constant (059)

MappingTimeSpec.description: Time value: a path with a format and zone, or the receive time. Must agree with the source's `observedAtMode` (059)

MappingField.description: One payload field produced by a RecordMapping (059)

unit.description: Unit conversion from the built-in UCUM table; unknown pairs fail validation

default.description: Value used when the path is absent or holds a sentinel

sentinels.description: Input values treated as absent (e.g. AIS heading 511), compared before conversion

RecordMapping.description: Declarative mapping from an inbound JSON, form or query-string payload to normalized records (059). Data, not script: no expression language. JSONPath is the Jayway dialect (`$` is the document, or the current item under `select`; `['a-b']` quotes a member name); deep scan (`..`), function calls and regex filters (`=~`) are rejected. Unknown members are rejected.

select.description: Optional JSONPath producing an array; one record per item, other paths item-relative

kind.description: Required unless the source has exactly one kind

geometry.description: Point from lon/lat specs, a GeoJSON geometry at a path, a constant point, or null (omitted). A coordinate outside the valid range (an AIS sentinel such as lat 91 or lon 181) leaves the geometry out with a GEOMETRY_OUT_OF_RANGE warning. `fallback` (059) is the point used when the mapped values give none, such as a LoRaWAN device's configured position.

fallback.description: [lon, lat] used when lon/lat (or geojson) give no geometry
[lon, lat] used when lon/lat (or geojson) give no geometry

tombstone.description: A record whose value at `path` equals `equals` (or is in `in`) is a tombstone

extra.description: Namespaced quality extras (Quality.extra), e.g. `lora.rssi`; scalar values only

fields.description: Payload fields, in order. A name may repeat: the first entry with a value wins (several sensors feeding one field, e.g. airrohr `pm25` from SDS011, PMS or SPS30). A value that cannot be coerced to `type`, or is NaN or infinite, leaves that field out with a FIELD_REJECTED warning.

pairs.description: Flattens name/value arrays (e.g. airrohr `sensordatavalues`); fields then reference `$pairs.<key>`

drop.description: Input keys never stored (secrets, device identifiers)

filter.description: Records failing any condition are skipped and counted

spread.description: Copies the scalar members of one object into top-level fields (ChirpStack `object`, TTS `decoded_payload`). Members in `drop`, members whose name is not a valid field name, and names a field already produced are skipped (059)

type.description: Type every copied value must have; others are skipped

MappingSample.description: A raw inbound sample for preview or suggestion; form and query inputs are converted to a flat JSON object of strings before mapping (059)

body.description: Raw body as a string, or a JSON value for JSON samples

query.description: Raw query string or name→value map (GET protocols such as WU)

MappingWarning.description: Non-fatal mapping finding: unmapped input key, field not in the source's fieldSpecs, a policy-required significant field missing, or a time-base mismatch (059)

MappingRejection.description: An input item that produced no record (059)

MappingPreviewRequest.description: Preview request: a mapping and a sample, optionally checked against an existing custom source (059)

sourceId.description: Custom source whose kinds, fieldSpecs, policy and observedAtMode are checked

MappingPreviewResult.description: What ingest would write for a sample; nothing is persisted (059)

confirmEgress.description: Required true when the chat provider is remote (035 classification)

MappingSuggestResult.description: LLM-drafted mapping, validated and previewed; never stored or applied (059)

MappingPresetSetup.description: Device-side setup for a preset: instructions and the exact ingest URL (059). On a preset's catalogue entry `url` is a template; on creation it is concrete and contains the key once.

url.description: Concrete URL (creation response only; shown once)

MappingPreset.description: A built-in device preset: format, mapping and custom-source defaults (059)

mapping.description: null when the preset delegates to a built-in format (e.g. `alertmanager`)

CapturedSample.description: One redacted raw ingest request captured while `captureSamples` is on (059)

format.description: Format path segment, null for the default endpoint

MappingTestRequest.description: Optional proposed mapping to test against captured samples; omit to test the stored mapping (059)

MappingTestResult.description: Mapping applied to each captured sample (059)

topicPrefix.description: Topic prefix; leading and trailing slashes are dropped. No + or # wildcards

haPrefix.description: Home Assistant discovery prefix; Foresignal subscribes to `{haPrefix}/status` for the birth message

haMaxRules.description: Most enabled rules given a `problem` binary_sensor, critical first, then by name

haMaxSources.description: Most non-private, non-disabled sources given a `problem` binary_sensor, by id

Telegram needs a bot used only by this Foresignal instance; Matrix rooms must be unencrypted.

allowedChats.description: The chats that may command, each mapped to `read` or `agent` scope (never `admin`). Messages from any other chat or user are ignored silently. bearerToken.description: Scoped API token (read < agent < admin). The bootstrap admin token is printed once on first start. Required scope per operation is in `x-foresignal-scope`. A login session bearer (`fss_<base64url>`, from `login`, R2-003) is accepted in the same header: it carries the coarse scope derived from its user's effective permissions, ends after 12 hours or 2 hours idle, and is never accepted on ingest or peer endpoints.

ingestKeyBasic.description: Custom-source ingest key (`eik_`, 024) or device key (`eid_`, 039) sent as the Basic-auth password (any username), for devices that only support Basic auth (OwnTracks HTTP mode).

registrationToken.description: One-time EDP registration token (024) for POST /v1/external/register.

feedKey.name: feedKey
feedKey.description: Feed key (`fsf_<base64url>`, 035) carried as the path segment after `/v1/k/`, not as a query parameter: `/v1/k/{key}/<rest>` serves `GET`/`HEAD /v1/<rest>` when `/v1/<rest>` starts with one of the key's prefixes. OpenAPI has no path-segment API key, so this scheme documents the carrier only and no operation lists it; see `info.description`. Unknown key → 401 INVALID_FEED_KEY; expired or revoked → 410 FEED_KEY_GONE; another method → 405; a path outside the prefixes or an operation that is not a `read` data operation → 403 RESTRICTED. Tile keys (`fsk_`, 050) use the same carrier with their own refusals: unknown, expired or revoked → 401 INVALID_TILE_KEY; outside the prefixes → 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (see `createTileKey`).

ingestKeyPath.name: ingestKey
ingestKeyPath.description: Ingest key (`eik_`, only when the custom source has `allowPathKey: true`) or device key (`eid_`, 039) carried as the path segment after `/k/` in `/v1/ingest/{sourceId}/k/{key}/{format}`, not as a query parameter, for apps that cannot send credentials (OsmAnd/Traccar Client, GPSLogger). OpenAPI has no path-segment API key, so this scheme documents the carrier. The key is redacted from every log line and fetch-log URL. Unknown or revoked key → 401; a key of another source → 401; `eik_` without `allowPathKey` → 404; a sender outside `ingestAllowCidrs` (default: private ranges only) → 403 INGEST_SOURCE_DENIED.

post.description:
Sent by a `webhook` channel for alerts, briefings, system events and tests (PUT when the channel is configured with method PUT; an operator `bodyTemplate` replaces the default body). Verify `X-Foresignal-Signature` as sha256=HMAC(hmacSecret, "<timestamp>.<body>") and reject stale timestamps. Non-2xx responses are retried at 10 s, 1 m, 5 m, 30 m and 2 h, then marked failed; 429 Retry-After is honoured and redirects are never followed. Lifecycle updates arrive as follow-ups with their own subtype.

**Scope:** `open` (outbound; scope does not apply).

parameters.name: X-Foresignal-Event
parameters.description: Event: alert, briefing, system or test

parameters.name: X-Foresignal-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds used in the signature

parameters.name: X-Foresignal-Signature
parameters.description: `sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(hmacSecret, "<timestamp>.<body>")>`; present when the channel has hmacSecret

parameters.name: X-Foresignal-Origin
parameters.description: Install id of the sending instance (loop guard)

parameters.name: X-Foresignal-Exercise
parameters.description: Present (`true`) when the delivery belongs to an exercise or replay (115); receivers should not page anyone

2XX.description: Accepted; any 2xx marks the delivery delivered

get.description:
Bodiless request to `watchdog.heartbeatUrl` every interval while readiness is UP (and the canary passes when enabled); `failUrl`, when set, receives the same request otherwise. 5 s timeout, no redirects.

**Scope:** `open` (outbound; scope does not apply).

post.description:
Same as the GET ping when `watchdog.method` is POST; empty body.

**Scope:** `open` (outbound; scope does not apply).

Sent by a `cloudevents` outbound sink (110): one structured-mode CloudEvent (`application/cloudevents+json`) or a batch (`application/cloudevents-batch+json`). Verify `X-Foresignal-Signature` exactly as for the notification webhook. Non-2xx responses are retried with backoff; the sink pauses after its failure budget.

**Scope:** `open` (outbound; scope does not apply).

parameters.name: X-Foresignal-Signature
parameters.description: sha256=HMAC(secret, "<timestamp>.<body>") when the sink has a secret

parameters.name: X-Foresignal-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds used in the signature

get.description:
Served by an EDP provider whose manifest declares `transport.pull`; Foresignal calls it every `intervalSeconds` with the stored cursor and follows `nextCursor` (docs/External-Data-Protocol.md §4.2). Auth as the manifest declares (`none`, `bearer`, `header`, `basic`) with the credential the operator entered.

**Scope:** `open` (outbound; scope does not apply).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response; absent on first call

get.description:
Optional; served by a provider whose manifest declares `transport.search`. Foresignal calls it for each cue (`SocialCueService`, 137): once per query, at most 10 queries a provider a cue, each admitted against the source's budget like a push (a refused call stops that provider for the cue with `BUDGET_EXCEEDED`), authenticated as `transport.search.auth` says. The response is read, validated and mapped like a push batch; a search result is never the end of a snapshot, so nothing it leaves out is deleted. The items are stored on the provider's source as cue results (`payload.collection = cue`, `payload.cueId`), which never feed baselines, and each provider's outcome is reported in `SocialCue.externalResults` (docs/External-Data-Protocol.md §4.3).

**Scope:** `open` (outbound; scope does not apply).
